about: Skills by case. Each project turns cases on in .claude/skill-cases.local.json ({"on": ["ui-ux", ...]}); the session-start hook lists the skills for the cases that are on. Community skills are read before first use. The kit owns this file; projects do not edit it.

cases.name: UI/UX design or review
cases.when: a screen, flow, component, form, error message or UI copy is designed, built or reviewed
cases.notes: The VectorLab skills (spacing, typography, forms, errors, empty-states, motion and the rest) load one by one as their topic comes up. A project's own visual style (for example a restrained motion rule) is project-only and lives in that project's standards.

cases.name: Building a feature
cases.when: new behaviour is planned and built

cases.name: Debugging
cases.when: a bug, a failing test or unexpected behaviour

cases.name: Review before a PR
cases.when: a branch is ready for its Pre-PR Deep Sweep

cases.name: Security-sensitive work
cases.when: auth, crypto, secrets, input handling or anything that sends data off the device

cases.name: ML and data work
cases.when: models, datasets, training, evals or data pipelines

cases.name: Cloudflare platform
cases.when: Workers, KV, R2, D1, Wrangler or other Cloudflare services

cases.name: Learning the decisions
cases.when: the owner wants a decision explained
